headline: Up Your Arsenal adds Daxx matches and functions carried over from Going Commando
summary: Up Your Arsenal merged 23 Daxx function matches and nine level functions adapted from Going Commando (#15). PAL v1.00's matched code rises from 19.70% to 19.84%, with 7,164 of 16,164 functions matched. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
highlights: The work also documents Daxx near misses and compiler patterns. Near misses remain separate from the matching additions (#15).
